canonical_statement: The study aimed to evaluate NGS-based genetic analysis as a practical antimicrobial-resistance surveillance tool and to characterize current Mycoplasma genitalium resistance-associated mutations in Japan.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We aimed to evaluate the utility of NGS–based genetic analysis as a practical tool for antimicrobial resistance surveillance and to clarify the current status of antimicrobial resistance in M. genitalium in Japan.

canonical_statement: The study analyzed 178 M. genitalium-positive residual clinical specimens collected across Japan from February through August 2025, with one specimen per patient.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We analyzed M. genitalium-positive specimens across Japan during February–August 2025... One specimen from each patient was included in this study. We analyzed 178 specimens

population.label: M. genitalium-positive residual clinical specimens from one specimen per patient

canonical_statement: The 178 specimens comprised 64 male urine specimens and 114 female cervical swab specimens.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We analyzed 178 specimens (64 male urine and 114 female cervical swab samples).

canonical_statement: Specimens came from Tokyo (106), Kawasaki (18), Yokohama (17), Nagoya (9), Osaka (12), and Fukuoka (16).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Geographically, the specimens were distributed as follows: 106 (59.6%) from Tokyo, 18 (10.1%) from Kawasaki, 17 (9.6%) from Yokohama, 9 (5.1%) from Nagoya, 12 (6.7%) from Osaka, and 16 (9.0%) from Fukuoka.

population.label: M. genitalium-positive specimens from six Japanese cities

canonical_statement: Specimens were fully anonymized and not linked to identifiable clinical data; specimen-level symptom status and the indication for M. genitalium testing were unavailable.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All specimens were fully anonymized and not linked to any identifiable clinical data. Therefore, no information regarding symptom status or indication for M. genitalium testing was available for each specimen.

canonical_statement: Target regions of 23S rRNA, gyrA, and parC were amplified by in-house multiplex PCR and sequenced on an Illumina MiSeq platform.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Target regions of the 23S rRNA, gyrA, and parC genes were amplified using in-house multiplex PCR... and analyzed by NGS on an Illumina MiSeq platform.

canonical_statement: Sanger sequencing was used for specimens with incomplete NGS results.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: For specimens with incomplete NGS results, Sanger sequencing was performed [7].

canonical_statement: Sex differences were tested with Fisher exact tests, city differences with Pearson chi-square tests, and p<0.05 was the statistical-significance threshold.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Differences in prevalence of individual mutations and variant patterns between sexes and among cities were analyzed using Fisher’s exact test or Pearson’s chi-square test, as appropriate. A p value of <0.05 was considered to indicate statistical significance.

canonical_statement: For this molecular surveillance analysis, amino-acid substitutions at GyrA residues 95/99 and ParC residues 83/87 were classified as fluoroquinolone resistance-associated mutations.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: for the purposes of this molecular surveillance study, we defined genetic mutations resulting in amino acid substitutions at residues 95 and 99 of GyrA and at residues 83 and 87 of ParC as fluoroquinolone resistance-associated mutations.

canonical_statement: A2071G, A2071T, and A2072G in 23S rRNA were classified as macrolide resistance-associated mutations in this study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Therefore, A2071G, A2071T, and A2072G were defined as macrolide resistance-associated mutations in this study.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that NGS is a useful and practical approach for large-scale surveillance involving multiple gene targets.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that fully susceptible M. genitalium strains were nearly absent in this Japanese sample because no strains were wild type at gyrA, parC, and 23S rRNA simultaneously.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study showed the near-complete absence of fully susceptible M. genitalium strains in Japan as no strains simultaneously harboring wild-type gyrA, parC, and 23S rRNA genes were identified.

canonical_statement: The authors interpreted the resistance findings as evidence of widespread dissemination of antimicrobial-resistant M. genitalium in Japan.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: These findings provide robust evidence that antimicrobial-resistant M. genitalium strains are widely disseminated throughout Japan and that resistance has reached an advanced and potentially saturated stage at the population level.

canonical_statement: The authors argued that the observed resistance status creates an urgent need to revise treatment strategies and develop new therapeutic options.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: underscoring the urgent need to revise current treatment strategies and develop new therapeutic options.
